command:
set -eu
for f in /var/mnt/rootfs/System/Library/Frameworks/CydiaSubstrate.framework/CydiaSubstrate \
         /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/lib/libmachook.dylib \
         /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/lib/libmachook_arm64e.dylib \
         /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/lib/libmachook_arm64.dylib \
         /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/mshook_provider_probe \
         /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe; do
  /var/jb/usr/bin/python3 -c "import hashlib,sys;print(sys.argv[1],hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()).hexdigest())" "$f"
done
echo "=== sentinel ==="
ls /tmp/macws_runtime_diagnostics 2>&1 || echo "sentinel absent (good)"
echo "=== processes ==="
ps aux | grep -iE "windowserver|evprobe|mshook" | grep -v grep || echo "(none)"
